display_long_description:
The Renaissance 3D Art Gallery is an Art Gallery that presents 48 Paintings of the Renaissance. The Renaissance was a European period of history and cultural movement taking place at the end of the Late Middle Ages and the beginning of the early modern era.
The Renaissance period is usually seen as being from the 14th to 17th Century.

In this VR Experience you can see paintings of different authors like:
- Pieter Bruegel the Elder
- Huybrecht Beuckeleer
- Piero della Francesca
- Pieter Aertsen
- Niccolò dell'Abbate
... and others

And walk around an elegant place to visit while you see Paintings of Renaissance authors, you can also see an approximate 3D representation of each painting as a sculpture. Some paintings only show a version of the Painting with relief, but others you can see a 3D Sculpture of the painting which enhance the experience.

Limitations:
The sculptures presented in this experience are low poly (not highly detailed), for that reason it can lack details on small sculptures and contain errors, for example small persons can have a weird face or no face at all, or the grapes can be not clearly divided, but in general you can see a nice approximation of what it would look like the paintings you are looking as a sculpture.
